faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about discovering offers and using RizqifyBD.

items.question: How do I find offers for my specific operator?
items.answer: Use the operator filter on the offers page to show only offers from Grameenphone, Banglalink, Robi, Airtel or Teletalk.

items.question: Are the prices final or are there additional fees?
items.answer: The displayed selling price is what you pay and any discounts are already applied. Where a payment method carries its own charges, those are shown before you confirm the order.

items.question: How do I check an offer's validity and availability?
items.answer: Each offer card shows its validity period and availability status. Offers that have expired or are unavailable are marked and cannot be ordered.

items.question: Can I purchase an offer for someone else's number?
items.answer: Yes. During the order process you enter the mobile number the offer should be applied to, whether that is your own number or someone else's.

items.question: How do I view my past orders?
items.answer: Sign in and open your dashboard. The My Orders section lists your complete order history with status, dates and amounts.

items.question: Do I need an account to explore offers?
items.answer: You can browse the offer catalogue freely. An account is only required when you are ready to place an order and manage your order and transaction history.
